positions.title: Software Engineer Fellow
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
-Selective program focusing on providing CS fundamentals and open source projects that are in demand at the company with my project being expected to facilitate and assist every team wanting to use an F# client-server architecture in the company
-Created an F# server framework from scratch that uses a custom set of implementations to read from a binary stream, decode into a typed query, run the given callback, and then encode a typed response back into the network stream 
-Explicitly managed threads for every connected client to allow for constantly reading a binary stream as well as running provided implementation functions in parallel
-Learned Ocaml while building client-server multiplayer game and a trading bot that participated in an electronic trading exchange
